mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. Have you ever felt like you're racing through your days—juggling work, family, and your own dreams—yet somehow still falling behind? You're not alone. In this fast-paced world, the lines between our responsibilities and our joys often blur, making it tough to find even a moment to breathe, let alone truly enjoy the present. Together, let's step into the world Brigid Schulte explores in her insightful book, Overwhelmed: Work, Love, and Play When No One Has the Time. Here, she invites us to look beneath the surface—beyond our overflowing calendars—to see how cultural pressures, shifting roles, and economic changes quietly shape our daily lives. This isn't just about our personal struggles to find balance—it's about a society that's always pushing us to do more, to be more, and to somehow squeeze meaning into every spare second. But what if there’s another way? As we explore Schulte’s stories and research together, we’ll discover not just the hidden costs of constant busyness, but also the hope that comes from carving out space for what truly matters—love, connection, and a bit of play. So, as we begin this journey, let's open ourselves up to new ideas about living well, and imagine how we might reclaim our own time—even when the world refuses to slow down.
